jobs.title: Director, Product Management - Data Platform
jobs.description:
The Basics:

Summary
Our Product Management team is actively seeking a new Director of Product Management focused on Data Platform, Cloud, and SaaS Architecture to join our passionate, driven, and fast-paced team. In this role, you will own and shape Tanium’s end-to-end data strategy across cloud and SaaS environments, partnering closely with engineering, product, design, and cross-functional leadership to define how Tanium stores, accesses, queries, moves, and visualizes data across the platform.

You will bring deep experience in cloud and SaaS architectures, data platforms, and enterprise-scale systems, with the ability to translate complex customer, product, and technical requirements into actionable strategy and execution. You will need to be successful influencing cross-functionally across all levels of the organization, operating horizontally across multiple teams and pods, and drive clarity in ambiguous, complex technical domains. You must also be comfortable setting strategic direction while staying close enough to the work to make high-quality product and architecture decisions.

This is an individual contributor role.

Responsibilities

- Own the product strategy and roadmap for Tanium’s cloud/SaaS data platform, from ideation through launch, in close partnership with engineering teams.

- Define and drive the short- and long-term roadmap for Tanium’s end-to-end data architecture, including storage, access, query, visualization, and data movement capabilities.

- Partner with Product Managers, Engineering, Design, and leadership across the organization to align priorities across multiple pods and ensure teams are building toward a cohesive data strategy.

- Lead product direction for how data is surfaced and experienced in Atlas and the UI, with a focus on improving trust, usability, reliability, and customer value.

- Drive the strategy for data movement and integration capabilities, including export, import, and scalable data exchange patterns across products and use cases.

- Establish clear product requirements, technical specifications, use cases, business logic, and success metrics for data platform capabilities.

- Partner with engineering leadership to make durable architectural decisions across complex, distributed cloud and SaaS systems.

- Champion data quality as a core product priority, setting expectations and mechanisms to improve consistency, reliability, and trust throughout the data lifecycle.

- Collaborate with internal teams on enablement, training, and launch materials to ensure successful adoption of new data capabilities and platform improvements.

- Work closely with business, technical, customer-facing, and go-to-market teams to understand customer needs, solve daily challenges, and identify opportunities for product differentiation.

- Leverage innovation and trends in cloud, SaaS, data architecture, analytics, and enterprise platform technologies to develop strategic solutions.

Requirements

Education

- BA/BS required

- MA/MS or equivalent advanced technical/business degree preferred

Experience

- 8+ years of total professional experience in enterprise B2B software, with at least 5 years in product management supporting a SaaS, cloud platform, data platform, infrastructure, or security technology product.

- Proven experience leading product strategy for complex technical platforms, including the ability to define opportunities, translate customer needs into requirements, and deliver products at enterprise scale.

- Deep experience with cloud and SaaS architectures, with strong working knowledge of hyperscaler environments such as Azure and/or AWS.

- Strong data platform experience, including one or more of the following:

- Data storage and data access architectures

- Query layers and large-scale database systems

- Data visualization and analytics experiences

- Data movement, export/import, integration, or interoperability capabilities

- Data quality, reliability, governance, and lifecycle considerations

- Experience working across distributed systems and multiple product surfaces, rather than a single narrowly defined application or monolith.

- Experience with large-scale enterprise data systems; experience with graph databases is a plus.

- Strong track record of working with engineering and business stakeholders to drive product definition, strategic alignment, prioritization, and execution.

- Demonstrated ability to lead through ambiguity, quickly ramp into new technical domains, and bring structure to broad, evolving problem spaces.

- Proven ability to influence horizontally across cross-functional teams, product pods, and senior stakeholders.

- Technology background preferred, ideally with experience in security, systems management, IT operations, cloud infrastructure, data platforms, or enterprise platform products.

Nice to have

- Experience with graph databases or graph-based data models.

- Experience with large-scale database systems, analytics platforms, or enterprise data visualization products.

- Broader hyperscaler depth across Azure, AWS, and/or other cloud providers.

- Experience building durable export/import patterns and integrations across complex enterprise products.

- Experience leading product teams through organizational growth, hiring, or team structure evolution.

About Tanium

Tanium is the Autonomous IT company. As Al accelerates both innovation and risk, Tanium Atlas, the company's autonomous operating system, puts the full depth of the Tanium Autonomous IT Platform behind every IT and security operator - human and agentic. Tanium provides the real-time intelligence, agentic decision-making, and autonomous execution operators needed to detect, decide, and remediate at machine speed across their endpoint estate.

The company is recognized as a Leader in the inaugural 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Endpoint Management Tools, as a Leader in the IDC MarketScape: Worldwide Client Endpoint Management Software for Windows Device Management 2025-2026 Vendor Assessment, and as a Leader in The Forrester Wave™. Endpoint Management Platforms, Q2 2026.

To learn how Tanium delivers Autonomous IT for unstoppable business, visit  www.tanium.com  and follow us on  LinkedIn  and  X .

On a mission. Together.

At Tanium, we are stewards of a culture that emphasizes the importance of collaboration, respect, and diversity. In our pursuit of revolutionizing the way some of the largest enterprises and governments in the world solve their most difficult IT challenges, we are strengthened by our unique perspectives and by our collective actions.

As a global organization with stakeholders around the world, it’s imperative that the diversity of our customers and communities is reflected internally in our team members. We strive to create a diverse and inclusive environment where everyone feels they have opportunities to succeed and grow because we know that only together can we do great things.

We are looking for a Director, Product Partnerships - Technical Partnerships & Programs to support and expand strategic partnership opportunities at the intersection of enterprise software, AI, and endpoint management. In this role you will help manage relationships with AI model providers, technology partners, and adjacent ecosystem players; analyze and advance new partnership opportunities; support joint go-to-market initiatives; and contribute to partner-sourced growth opportunities. This is a mission-driven, customer-first role that calls for a strong background in business development or strategic partnerships, strong analytical and collaboration skills, and a passion for advancing Tanium’s mission to protect people, defend data, and secure systems.

This position follows the Company’s hybrid schedule which currently requires employees to work in the office at one of the following locations a minimum of three days per week: Addison, TX; Bellevue, WA; Durham, NC; Emeryville, CA; or Reston, VA.

What you’ll do:

- Evaluate and prioritize strategic opportunities: Conduct market research, partner landscaping, and opportunity analysis to identify high-potential AI, OEM, and adjacent ecosystem partnerships. Build quantitative models and business cases to help evaluate partner fit, commercial potential, customer impact, and strategic value.

- Develop joint solutions and GTM initiatives: Work closely with partners to define mutual goals and co-create joint solutions. Support go-to-market plans such as product integrations, co-marketing programs, co-sell motions, sales plays, and field enablement that generate pipeline and drive new revenue for both Tanium and its partners.

- Support OEM and technology partnership execution: Help identify, structure, and advance OEM or technology licensing opportunities that extend Tanium’s reach through third-party platforms, particularly across SIEM, SOAR, ITAM, ITSM, AI ops, and adjacent enterprise software categories.

- Cross-functional collaboration: Coordinate with internal teams — including Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Legal, Finance, and Enablement — to ensure successful evaluation, development, launch, and ongoing support of partner initiatives.

- Champion partners internally: Serve as an advocate for strategic partners within Tanium. Educate and enable internal stakeholders on each partner’s value proposition, partnership goals, and how to leverage partnerships to better serve customers.

Familiarity with co-selling models, OEM partnerships, technology integrations, and ecosystem program development is a plus.

- Strategic and analytical mindset: Ability to think strategically about mutual business opportunities while executing tactically. Comfortable using data, market research, and financial analysis to model opportunities, measure outcomes, and inform decision-making.

- AI and technology ecosystem fluency: Familiarity with AI/ML platform companies, frontier labs, AI-native startups, or enterprise AI workflows. Understanding of the enterprise security or IT operations landscape — including endpoint management, SIEM, SOAR, ITAM, XDR, or AI ops — is strongly preferred.

- Excellent communication & influence: Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to collaborate across internal teams and engage credibly with external partner stakeholders. Able to clearly articulate Tanium’s value proposition and enthusiastically evangelize the Tanium message to partners and customers.

- Cross-functional collaboration skills: Proven ability to work across Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, Legal, Finance, and Enablement to drive alignment in a matrixed, fast-paced environment. Adept at building consensus and maintaining strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

- Drive and adaptability: A self-starter who thrives in a high-growth, rapidly evolving environment, capable of managing multiple initiatives and adapting quickly to change while maintaining focus on results.

jobs.location: Addison, TX (Hybrid); Bellevue, WA (Hybrid); Durham, NC (Hybrid); Emeryville, CA (Hybrid); Reston, VA (Hybrid)
jobs.description:
The Basics:

As Director of Product Marketing for Tanium’s Autonomous MSP solution, you will own the positioning, messaging, launches, and partner-facing marketing for a growing part of Tanium’s business. MSPs already run on Tanium today, and we are investing to make Tanium the platform managed service providers standardize on. The Autonomous MSP solution gives them a fundamentally different way to operate: with Tanium Atlas, the platform surfaces the most important things that matter across all of an MSP’s customers, cutting through the alert fatigue of traditional tools and letting operators act at scale rather than customer by customer.

You will be the person who translates that value into an offering an MSP can adopt, bundle into a managed service, and sell to its own customers. You will market to two audiences at once: to MSPs, convincing them to adopt and build a practice on Tanium’s platform, and through MSPs, arming their sellers to bring Tanium to end customers. You will set the strategy and the story, and draw on Tanium’s corporate marketing, field marketing, and partner enablement teams to bring it to market at scale.

You will work as part of the Autonomous MSP product team with a direct line into product management and engineering to influence functionality, roadmap priorities, packaging, and pricing. Beyond the team, you will work closely with product marketers in other solution areas, such as Exposure Management and Endpoint Management, as well as partner sales, partner enablement, finance, corporate and field marketing, analyst relations, and Tanium’s MSP partners.

This position follows the Company’s hybrid schedule which currently requires employees to work in the office at one of the following locations a minimum of three days per week: Addison, TX; Bellevue, WA; Durham, NC; Emeryville, CA; or Reston, VA.

What You’ll Do:

- Own positioning and messaging for the MSP audience, translating the Autonomous MSP value proposition into outcomes MSPs care about: technician productivity, margin, service differentiation, and customer retention

- Own launches for the Autonomous MSP solution, including announcement narrative, launch content, field and partner readiness, and post-launch iteration based on partner feedback

- Share responsibility with partner sales and product management for the MSP GTM plan and the cross-functional cadence that tracks outcomes, gathers partner feedback, and cascades it into product direction, pricing, and program design

Experience:

- Education

- BA or BS required

- MBA preferred

- Experience

- 8+ years in product marketing, partner marketing, channel marketing, or outbound product management at a B2B technology company

- Direct experience marketing a technology platform to or through managed service providers, at a vendor whose revenue runs substantially through MSPs, at an MSP, or at a distributor or marketplace serving MSPs, with working fluency in the MSP ecosystem (RMM and PSA platforms, distributors and marketplaces, peer groups, and industry events)

- Demonstrated understanding of MSP business models, including how MSPs price and margin managed services, and what drives their tooling and platform decisions

- Experience taking a new offering or route to market from pre-launch through launch, including field and partner readiness

- Exposure to packaging, pricing, and licensing for channel or consumption-based models

- Preferred

- Experience marketing AI, automation, or agentic capabilities to a technical operator audience

- Experience in endpoint management or cybersecurity, particularly MS P or managed security service offerings

- Existing relationships across the MSP community, and public speaking or industry-event experience

- Other

- Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to write for a practitioner-owner audience that is skeptical of enterprise marketing

- Comfortable as a hands-on individual contributor who produces the work directly, while operating at a director level of strategic ownership and navigating a large organization to get it done
